Subject: Aurora status-service cutover - Lakeshore Retail pilot
Content: The November 20 status-service cutover is still the plan. The Lakeshore Retail expansion on November 23 will use the event-driven service. A fix confined to the legacy polling path will not resolve that pilot's issue.

Subject: Aurora Sprint 24 has started
Content: Aurora Sprint 24 runs October 26 to November 20. The sprint board is in EngHub. Raise any scope change here and bring it to LT for approval.
